title: FD-VAD：流式全双工语音的语义端点检测
summary: FD-VAD提出一种无需ASR的流式语义端点检测方法，将因果音频窗口直接映射为Continue/Stop决策，结合冻结语音编码器、模态适配器和参数高效微调的语言模型，在TurnBench上取得0.853的EOT召回率。
summary_en: FD-VAD introduces an ASR-free streaming semantic endpoint detector that maps causal audio windows directly to Continue/Stop decisions, combining a frozen speech encoder, modality adapter, and parameter-efficiently adapted language model, achieving 0.853 EOT recall on TurnBench.
